questions.question: What does normalize("The June 29, 2007") remove before comparison?
options: Case differences, articles, punctuation, and extra whitespace
All digits and every month name
The meaning of the sentence through stemming
questions.explanation: normalize lowercases, removes a/an/the, replaces non-word characters with spaces, and collapses whitespace.

questions.question: What does exact_match("The cat", "cat") return?
questions.explanation: After normalization both strings become cat, so exact_match returns one.

questions.question: What token F1 does token_f1("June 29th 2007", "June 29 2007") produce?
questions.explanation: Two of three tokens overlap, giving precision=recall=2/3 and an F1 of 2/3.

questions.question: Does refusal_from_score(0.3, threshold=0.3) refuse the answer?
options: Only if the answer contains a date
No, because the function ignores threshold entirely
No; refusal uses the strict condition score < threshold
questions.explanation: The helper returns top_retrieval_score < threshold, so equality at 0.3 is accepted.

questions.question: What makes the first iPhone document score for the query "When was the first iPhone released?"?
options: Shared query tokens such as first, iPhone, and released contribute to toy_bm25_score
The document is always selected because it is first in CORPUS
Only the document punctuation is compared
The score comes from an external neural retriever
questions.explanation: toy_bm25_score counts matching query terms and normalizes by document length; toy_retrieve sorts these scores.

questions.question: Why can token F1 be useful alongside exact match for extractive QA?
options: It guarantees semantic equivalence for any paraphrase
It gives partial credit when predicted and gold answers share some tokens but are not identical strings
It ignores missing answer tokens to favor longer predictions
It replaces retrieval and never needs a gold answer
questions.explanation: F1 balances token precision and recall, while exact match is an all-or-nothing normalized string test.
